From: Colin Thomas-Jensen <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, November 15, 2021 10:17 PM
To: Shaarik Zafar
Cc: Devermont, Judd B. EOP/NSC; Brian Rice; Johnny Walsh
Subject: Re: Introduction
Hi Shaarik—Very nice to meet you virtually. Thanks for the Ethiopia update. That's obviously a situation we are closely
tracking for a lot of different reasons. I'm out the remainder of the week for family reasons but it would be great to meet
with the two of you. I'm adding my colleague Johnny Walsh, who leads USAID's democracy and human rights work.
Regards
Colin
Sent from my iPhone
On Nov 14, 2021, at 10:19 PM, Shaarik Zafar < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Judd,
Great seeing you on Friday, it was nice to catch up. Thanks also for the introduction to Colin.
Colin, great to be connected. I worked closely with USAID during my previous stints at the NSC, State,
and in the IC.
I'm copying Brian Rice who is our VP for US Policy who leads our engagement with the
Administration. Also, in case it's of interest, here an update on our work re: Ethiopia, which our East

Africa team recently published. [link omitted] omitted]/news/2021/11/update-on-ethiopia/.
Best,
Shaarik

Shaarik H. Zafar

From: "Devermont, Judd B. EOP/NSC" < [contact omitted]›
Date: Friday, November 12, 2021 at 3:35 PM
To: Shaarik Zafar < [contact omitted]>, 'Colin Thomas-Jensen' <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Introduction
Shaarik,
I want to introduce you Colin Thomas-Jensen, USAID's National Security Adviser. Colin is one of the
sharpest people I know, and he has deep expertise on Ethiopia. I know he'll be able to walk vou
through our concerns about hate speech, disinformation, and the risk of more ethnic violence ir
Ethiopia.
Regards,
Judd Devermont
Special Advisor for Africa Strategy
National Security Council
